final.name: Staccato repetition or fragmenting punctuation
final.audit_justification: Measures only the presence of a rhythmic punctuation device, explicitly excluding whether the emphasis actually lands, making it an orthographic/typographic habit rather than a substance judgment.

final.name: Freshness over stockness
final.audit_justification: Directly evaluates originality of premise and wording versus reliance on stock joke templates, a core craft dimension of comedic writing.

final.name: Stock dialogue scaffolding
final.audit_justification: Tallies presence of familiar dialogue-opener templates while explicitly refusing to judge whether the setup works, making it a boilerplate/template-phrasing marker rather than a quality judgment.

final.name: Vivid scene specificity
final.audit_justification: Assesses concrete, evocative scene-building versus generic interchangeable phrasing, a genuine craft/imagery quality.

final.name: No self-commentary on its own funniness
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the caption stays in-scene versus breaks into meta-commentary on its own humor, a recognized show-don't-tell craft principle.

final.name: Compactness with payload
final.audit_justification: Directly evaluates economy of language -- whether every word contributes or padding weakens the joke -- a substantive craft judgment, not a raw length count.

final.name: Copyediting normalization
final.audit_justification: Scores visible copyediting/formatting conventions while explicitly disclaiming quality, a production/proofreading fingerprint whose upstream cause (careful preparation) could also plausibly track genuinely more careful composition.

final.name: Sustained double meaning across the whole line
final.audit_justification: Evaluates whether a double meaning is sustained coherently across the whole line versus confined to one clever word, a genuine wordplay-craft distinction.

final.name: Phonetic wordplay compressed into a single word
final.audit_justification: Measures only the density of sound-based wordplay as a device, explicitly excluding whether the pun works or is good, so it is a device-presence marker rather than an execution judgment.

final.name: Pandemic or geopolitical event-pinning vocabulary
final.audit_justification: Flags dateable real-world event references as a temporal/topical tell, explicitly independent of whether the reference is used cleverly.
final.upstream_parent: submission timing pinned to a specific real-world event or era (pandemic, geopolitical conflict) rather than a timeless reading of the cartoon

final.name: Identity-role markers
final.audit_justification: Tallies explicit social-role labels while disclaiming portrayal quality, a subject-matter marker, though its upstream cause -- attentive characterization -- could also plausibly yield genuinely richer, more vivid writing.

final.name: Throat-clearing before the joke
final.audit_justification: The scale explicitly frames economical, filler-free openings as stronger and preamble-heavy openings as weaker, an evaluative craft judgment about wasted setup rather than a neutral presence tally.

final.name: Clash between elevated/formal diction and mundane scene
final.audit_justification: Scores register mismatch specifically as a device that produces comic contrast, tying the measurement to a comedic mechanism rather than treating it as a neutral style tell.

final.name: Exact wordplay fit
final.audit_justification: Directly judges whether wordplay is precise and semantically apt versus strained, an execution-quality judgment on craft.

final.name: Quantification density
final.audit_justification: Tallies explicit quantification by extent only, disclaiming whether the specificity is good, though attentiveness to concrete detail could also plausibly produce genuinely more vivid writing.

final.name: Cultural specificity
final.audit_justification: Counts named people/brands/places/media as topic markers while disclaiming aptness or humor, though the same attentiveness to specific detail could also plausibly produce genuinely more vivid, well-crafted scenes.
final.upstream_parent: author cultural network or audience familiarity

final.name: Speaker asserts and acts, rather than asking and hedging
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the speaker's line has narrative force that changes the situation versus leaves it inert, an evaluative judgment about the caption's dramatic payload rather than a neutral topic tell.

final.name: Coherent causal twist
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the punchline follows a coherent, inferable causal chain versus arbitrary juxtaposition, a core craft criterion for joke construction.

final.name: Distinctive speaker voice
final.audit_justification: Evaluates whether the diction creates a distinctive, non-interchangeable speaker voice, a genuine characterization/craft quality.

final.name: Late twist or escalation in the final clause
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether the caption builds an expectation and delivers a genuine turn at the close, a structural craft judgment about comic timing.

final.name: Off-colour, bodily and dark-subject content
final.audit_justification: Tallies the presence and intensity of taboo/bodily content types while explicitly refusing to judge whether the transgression is funny or well-handled, a pure subject-matter classification.

final.name: Idiomatic frame transformation
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a familiar idiom or reference is transformed into a fresh, situation-specific meaning versus merely repeated, a genuine wordplay-craft distinction.

final.name: Meaningful numerical specificity
final.audit_justification: Explicitly evaluates whether a numerical detail intensifies and vivifies the joke, tying the measurement to comedic effect rather than mere presence.

final.name: Genre-pastiche of a non-cartoon written register
final.audit_justification: Flags presence of a borrowed genre's fixed phrasing convention while explicitly disclaiming whether the pastiche is executed well, a template/register marker, though convincingly mimicking another genre plausibly requires the same writerly control that produces genuinely better work.

final.name: Directness on taboo or transgressive subject matter
final.audit_justification: Scores the caption's rhetorical commitment -- stating taboo content plainly versus cushioning it -- as a narrative delivery choice, though it sits close to being a content-tone marker.
